the combination of clustering, prototype based boosting and nearest neighbour classifier is a very effective approach for classification of large data.

(i) A large handwritten data can be effectively handled with a combination of clustering, prototype based learning, and AdaBoost; and (ii) A large handwritten dataset can be effectively classified with a very small number of prototypes.

the development of a novel approach to classification of large handwritten digit data using AdaBoost and leader clustering algorithm.
the development of an efficient algorithm for classification of large data using AdaBoost and leader algorithm.

, the proposed algorithm is computationally efficient as well as accurate.
we propose a novel method for classification of large data, which uses a single pass clustering algorithm and a base classifier that employs prototypes.
, we have developed a novel method that uses the leader algorithm for clustering and AdaBoost as boosting algorithm with the nearest neighbour classifier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in a large data, clustering can play an important role in boosting.
, in the context of large data, the use of prototypes in boosting is an effective way to improve the classification accuracy.
